description: Routing rules for source-backed paraphrase evidence. This file defines HUD route behavior only; it is not a dictionary and does not import English translations.

route_families.source_scope: Imported license-safe Hebrew biblical source text.
evidence_required: focused Hebrew token, lemma, or subphrase
route_families.meaning_rule: The row may show a project-authored plain-language paraphrase of how the cited Hebrew usage bears on the focused token. It must not present that paraphrase as an imported translation.
route_families.ordering_rule: Can become the winning answer only if no stronger strict Hebrew, strict Aramaic, morphology, or lemma route wins after route scoring.

route_families.source_scope: Imported license-safe Hebrew Torah literature outside the biblical route, such as Midrash, Zohar/Tikkunei, Gra, Rav Kook, or other accepted Hebrew source layers.
evidence_required: focused Hebrew token, lemma, or subphrase
route_families.meaning_rule: The row may show a project-authored plain-language paraphrase of the cited source's usage or expansion. It must stay visibly separate from dictionary definitions and from biblical paraphrase evidence.
route_families.ordering_rule: Can become the winning answer only if no stronger strict Hebrew, strict Aramaic, morphology, lemma, subphrase, or biblical paraphrase route wins after route scoring.

scoring_policy.display_percent: Show the route's own match percent plainly. Do not hide low scores.
scoring_policy.ordering_adjustment: Strict Hebrew and strict Aramaic routes receive a 20 point route-priority advantage over softer lemma, subphrase, biblical paraphrase, and citable paraphrase routes. The displayed percent remains the route's own percent.
scoring_policy.fallback_rule: If no strict route exists, any real licensed route family can carry the primary answer, including a low-percent paraphrase route.
scoring_policy.failed_route_rule: Failed routes are shown only as tiny audit traces.

hud_policy: No editorial prose in the HUD.
Show route type, language/source type, match type, percent, definition or paraphrase, and source/license.
Use plain language first; if a technical term is necessary, explain its significance immediately.
Keep source and license rows visible by default.

source_rows.notes: Project-authored route metadata only. No external dictionary text or English translation is imported.
